properties.title: Bosnia votes as pro-Russian politician looms large over race and a stalled EU bid dominate election
properties.summary: Around 3.4 million voters in Bosnia are choosing the three members of the country’s multi-ethnic presidency, lawmakers for the national Parliament, and heads of institutions for the country’s two entities.

properties.title: Germany’s Merz visits Kyiv amid fears of ‘hardest’ winter in war
properties.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv on Sunday morning for an unannounced one-day visit, which is expected to deliver new military, financial and economic support pledges but is also overshadowed by tensions over Ukraine’s desire to quickly join the EU. Merz is planning to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to discuss support against Russia’s escalating war, particularly in the sector of air defense and long-range offensive weapons, as well as peace initiatives.

properties.title: Azerbaijan, Turkey and Uzbekistan join forces in major military exercise
properties.summary: Thousands of military personnel from Azerbaijan, Turkey and Uzbekistan, as well as other nations participating as observers, including Iran, joined forces in the “Power of Unity, 2026” military exercise for the first time, in the Hojavend district of Azerbaijan’s Karabakh region.

properties.title: Russia expels Hungarian diplomats as Budapest breaks with Orbán era
properties.summary: Moscow ordered Hungarian embassy and consulate staff out just weeks after Budapest expelled 10 Russian diplomats on national security grounds in September, the first such move by Hungary since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
